definitions.gloss: mechanical; like a machine; done without thought
definitions.explanation: Describes actions or responses done automatically and without thought or feeling, like a machine. Can also literally mean 'relating to machines.'

examples.japanese: {機械的|きかいてき}な⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧。
⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{機械的|きかいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。

⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{機械的|きかいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}している→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}って→失う：01887_ushinau⟧しまう。
examples.english: If you mechanically repeat the same things every day, you end up losing interest in your work.

notes:
A な-adjective formed from ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧ (machine) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Most often used figuratively for behavior that is automatic and devoid of thought or emotion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機械的|きかいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to process mechanically
- {機械的|きかいてき}な⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧: a mechanical (unfeeling) reaction
- {機械的|きかいてき}な⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧: machine-like movement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自動的|じどうてき}→自動的：25589_jidouteki⟧: automatic — neutral; describes processes that happen by themselves, without the negative 'unfeeling' nuance
- {事務的|じむてき}: businesslike; impersonal — emphasizes coldness in dealing with people
